scope: 13 unique real UI checks against one unchanged runtime, reconciled from 12 passing controls checks and one focused outpost rerun. Both used isolated Chromium contexts and previously earned saves; clock skips and public actions prepare the scenarios. This is not a physical-device test or a browser-played earned combat campaign.

checks.name: V3 migration opens the earned town and preserves its V2 source save
Frontier exposes real quotes, region prerequisites and an interactive coastline
Named recruitment spends the exact quote and reserves a real resident through training
Frontier units and named labor survive save/reload without altering the V2 save
Accidental recruitment can cancel training at home, releasing labor without an equipment refund
An envoy spends real provisions, walks to first contact, and releases their town job on return
Mouse and touch company Move/Attack target actual world picks; Retreat keeps an explicit order
Neighbor trade, deliberate war, and a priced truce use their actual action quotes

detail.note: Paused after declaration; verifies real war state/garrison and withdrawal, not a won battle.

checks.name: A completed wall can be salvaged through its inspector for the exact visible refund
World targeting queues a paid wall line, named engineering completes it, and a gate opens/closes
Island chart and management controls fit a 390px phone viewport without hiding action text
No browser or application errors during actual frontier control checks
An earned outpost can be removed and rebuilt through the UI; claim loss blocks new buildings and preserves existing homes
